description: A critical delivery crosses the floor within its first minute (duration class short) and publishes. The operator janis records an expected-this-episode judgment against that exact view. The same symptom keeps firing unchanged for the next forty minutes (duration class plateaus to long); the floor re-fires on the same evidence and only edits the existing root — the judgment steers no deterministic outcome here, but is durably recorded and carried into the next L2 prompt.
